_comment: AzL Beacon - per-engagement validation config. Copy to validation-config.json and populate. validation-config.json is gitignored. All values below are examples.
_azureRegionNote: One of: eastus, westeurope, australiaeast, canadacentral, centralindia, southeastasia, japaneast, southcentralus, usgovvirginia. Selects the per-region endpoint list.
_oemNote: Optional OEM endpoint list appended to the sweep. Available: dell. Empty = none.
_ntpNote: Empty = the domain controllers, else time.windows.com. UDP/123 is probed and the clock offset reported.
_proxyNote: Explicit proxy for the HTTPS probes, e.g. http://proxy.example.com:8080. Bypass entries: host, *.domain, .domain, 192.0.2.0/24, <local>.
_arcGatewayNote: <id>.gw.arc.azure.com from your Arc gateway resource. Set = Arc gateway mode: endpoints the gateway carries are not probed directly; the gateway itself is.
_envCheckerNetworkNote: infraIpPools, managementSubnetCidr, hostNetworkIntents and a WinRM session to the node are needed for the Environment Checker NETWORK validator; without them it is reported as Skipped.
